title: The Modern Olympics
objective: After this level you can explain how the Olympics were revived in 1896.
summary: Pierre de Coubertin’s movement revived the Olympics in Athens in 1896; the marathon was new that year, and the torch relay only began in 1936.

cards.headline: The Olympics came back in 1896. Some of the oldest-looking parts were brand new.
cards.body: The revival borrowed a Greek name and a Greek stage. Then it invented traditions that look far older than they are.

cards.headline: A Frenchman’s revival
cards.body: The comeback was led by Pierre de Coubertin, a French educator. In 1894 a congress at the Sorbonne, in Paris, agreed to hold international Olympic Games and founded the International Olympic Committee. The first modern Games opened in Athens in 1896. A Greek festival, restarted by a Frenchman, back in Greece.

cards.headline: The newest old race
cards.body: The marathon was invented for those 1896 Games, inspired by the legend of a runner carrying news from Marathon to Athens. A Greek, Spyridon Louis, won it by more than seven minutes and became a national hero. The race that sounds most ancient was brand new, and the host country won it. Perfect ending.

mascot.line: This is Level 35’s legend: the race honors a run Herodotus never recorded.

cards.fact: The Olympic torch relay began in 1936, not in ancient Greece.
cards.context: It was created for the 1936 Berlin Games, staged by Nazi Germany. A flame was lit at Olympia with a mirror focusing the Sun’s rays, then runners carried it to Berlin. Ancient Greeks never ran a torch relay. It looks ancient because it was designed to.

cards.headline: The Olympics: revived
learned: Coubertin’s congress founded the IOC in 1894
The marathon was new; Spyridon Louis won it
The torch relay began in Berlin in 1936

questions.prompt: Which city hosted the first modern Olympic Games, in 1896?

options.label: Paris
options.rationale: The IOC was founded there in 1894.

options.label: Rome
options.rationale: The first modern Games went to Greece.

questions.explanation: The first modern Olympic Games opened in Athens in 1896.

questions.prompt: A TV host calls the Olympic torch relay an ancient Greek ritual. What’s the best correction?

options.label: It was first run for the 1936 Berlin Games
It was first run at Marathon in 490 BCE
options.rationale: There was no ancient torch relay.

options.label: Coubertin invented it for Athens in 1896
The Romans started it at Olympia

questions.explanation: The relay was created for the 1936 Berlin Games; ancient Greeks never ran one.

questions.prompt: The 1896 marathon honored a runner’s legend; from Level 35, which run does Herodotus actually record?

options.label: Marathon to Athens, announcing victory
options.rationale: That’s the later legend the race honors.

options.label: Athens to Sparta, asking for help
Olympia to Athens, carrying a flame
Athens to Delphi, asking the oracle

questions.explanation: Herodotus records Pheidippides running from Athens to Sparta before the battle; the dash to Athens that the race honors is later legend.
